comment: One row for each decision of the one-body ownership witness checker.
The stages compile the checker test, its producer test, and its report test.
Run this table in a Linux VM or on a native host after a debug build.
build: mkdir -p build/$(uname -s)/debug/witness-mutate && cd test/fort && ../../build/$(uname -s)/debug/fort -I ../../src/fort -I support ownership_witness_test.ft -o ../../build/$(uname -s)/debug/witness-mutate/ownership_witness_test
